items.name: Three-act
items.description: A classic frame: set up the world, test the hero with rising trouble, then resolve it.

slots.name: Act 1: Setup
slots.description: Introduce the people and world, then an event that pulls the lead into the problem.

slots.name: Act 2: Confrontation
slots.description: The lead pursues the goal while obstacles and stakes grow.

slots.name: Act 3: Resolution
slots.description: The main tension peaks and the central question gets answered.

items.name: Eight-sequence
items.description: Frank Daniel's approach: a feature as eight mini-stories of roughly equal length, two in the first act, four in the middle, two at the end.

slots.name: Sequence 1
slots.description: Opening world and the event that disturbs it.

slots.name: Sequence 2
slots.description: The lead reacts and decides to take on the problem.

slots.name: Sequence 3
slots.description: First pursuit of the goal in a new situation.

slots.name: Sequence 4
slots.description: Pressure builds toward a major turn at the middle.

slots.name: Sequence 5
slots.description: The turn changes the stakes and the plan.

slots.name: Sequence 6
slots.description: Setbacks mount and opposition tightens.

slots.name: Sequence 7
slots.description: Lowest point, then a final push begins.

slots.name: Sequence 8
slots.description: Climax and the new normal.

items.name: Save the Cat
items.description: Blake Snyder's 15-beat sheet, with beats placed by approximate position in a 110-page script.

slots.name: Opening image
slots.description: A first picture that sets tone and the starting state.

slots.name: Theme stated
slots.description: Someone hints at the lesson the lead will learn.

slots.name: Set-up
slots.description: Show the lead's world and what in it needs fixing.

slots.name: Catalyst
slots.description: An event that upends the lead's life.

slots.name: Debate
slots.description: The lead hesitates over what to do.

slots.name: Break into two
slots.description: The lead commits and enters the new world.

slots.name: B story
slots.description: A secondary thread, often a relationship, that carries the theme.

slots.name: Fun and games
slots.description: Deliver the premise's main appeal.

slots.name: Midpoint
slots.description: A false win or loss that raises stakes.

slots.name: Bad guys close in
slots.description: Opposition and inner doubts tighten.

slots.name: All is lost
slots.description: The lowest moment, something ends.

slots.name: Dark night of the soul
slots.description: The lead sits with defeat before an idea arrives.

slots.name: Break into three
slots.description: A solution clicks and the threads join.

slots.name: Finale
slots.description: The lead applies what was learned and settles the conflict.

slots.name: Final image
slots.description: A closing picture that echoes the opening and shows change.

items.name: Hero's Journey
items.description: Campbell's monomyth as condensed by Christopher Vogler into twelve stages: leave home, be tested, return changed.

slots.name: Ordinary world
slots.description: The hero's everyday life before the adventure.

slots.name: Call to adventure
slots.description: A challenge or invitation arrives.

slots.name: Refusal of the call
slots.description: Fear or doubt makes the hero hesitate.

slots.name: Meeting the mentor
slots.description: Guidance, a gift or confidence is gained.

slots.name: Crossing the first threshold
slots.description: The hero commits and enters the unknown.

slots.name: Tests, allies, enemies
slots.description: Learning the new world's rules and who to trust.

slots.name: Approach to the inmost cave
slots.description: Preparing to face the greatest danger.

slots.name: The ordeal
slots.description: The biggest crisis, a brush with loss.

slots.name: Reward
slots.description: Surviving brings a prize or insight.

slots.name: The road back
slots.description: The hero heads home, pursued by consequences.

slots.name: The resurrection
slots.description: A final test that proves the hero has changed.

slots.name: Return with the elixir
slots.description: The hero brings something of value back home.

items.name: Five-point
items.description: A compact arc: setup, a disruption, rising complications, a peak, and the fallout. Useful for shorts and quick sketches.

slots.name: Setup
slots.description: Who and where, and what normal looks like.

slots.name: Inciting moment
slots.description: The event that starts the story moving.

slots.name: Escalation
slots.description: Complications that raise the cost of the goal.

slots.name: Climax
slots.description: The decisive confrontation or choice.

slots.name: Resolution
slots.description: What changed and where things settle.

items.name: Story Circle
items.description: Dan Harmon's eight-step loop: a character leaves comfort, gets what they want at a price, and returns changed.

slots.name: You
slots.description: A character in a comfortable, familiar place.

slots.name: Need
slots.description: They want something.

slots.name: Go
slots.description: They enter an unfamiliar situation.

slots.name: Search
slots.description: They adapt and find their footing.

slots.name: Find
slots.description: They get what they wanted.

slots.name: Take
slots.description: They pay a heavy price for it.

slots.name: Return
slots.description: They go back to the familiar place.

slots.name: Change
slots.description: They are changed by the trip.

items.name: Kishotenketsu
items.description: East Asian four-part form built on a twist rather than on conflict.

slots.name: Ki: Introduction
slots.description: Present characters and setting.

slots.name: Sho: Development
slots.description: Follow the situation forward with no big change.

slots.name: Ten: Twist
slots.description: Turn to something unexpected that recasts what came before.

slots.name: Ketsu: Conclusion
slots.description: Bring the pieces together and close.

items.name: Hook, segments, CTA
items.description: A standard explainer or commentary video: win the first seconds, deliver in chunks, end with a clear next step.

slots.name: Hook
slots.description: Prove the title's promise right away.

slots.name: Context and roadmap
slots.description: Say why it matters and what is coming.

slots.name: Segments
slots.description: The main content in distinct chunks, with the strongest early.

slots.name: Call to action
slots.description: Point to one next step such as another video.

items.name: Story-driven video
items.description: A narrative or vlog arc: open on a stake, build to a turn, land the outcome.

slots.name: Cold open
slots.description: A striking moment or question from the story.

slots.name: Setup
slots.description: Who, where and what is at stake.

slots.name: Journey
slots.description: Attempts, obstacles and surprises.

slots.name: Payoff
slots.description: The outcome and the turn.

slots.name: Outro
slots.description: Reflection and next step.

items.name: Listicle or countdown
items.description: A numbered list video: a short hook, then parallel items, then a wrap-up.

slots.name: Hook
slots.description: Tease the list and its best item.

slots.name: Items
slots.description: Each item in a repeatable mini-format.

slots.name: Wrap-up
slots.description: Recap and next step.

items.name: Hook, build, payoff
items.description: The default vertical short: grab attention at once, build tension or value, then pay off.

slots.name: Hook
slots.description: An immediate visual or line that stops the scroll.

slots.name: Build
slots.description: Escalate with the steps, tension or setup.

slots.name: Payoff
slots.description: The reveal, result or punchline.

items.name: Loop
items.description: A short whose ending flows back into its opening so replays feel seamless.

slots.name: Opening
slots.description: A hook that also works as the follow-on of the ending.

slots.name: Body
slots.description: The main action or point.

slots.name: Loop-back
slots.description: A final beat that leads straight into the start.

items.name: Problem, solution, result
items.description: A quick how-to or tip: state the problem, show the fix, show the result.

slots.name: Problem
slots.description: Name the pain in one line.

slots.name: Solution
slots.description: Show the fix.

slots.name: Result
slots.description: Show the outcome.
